name: Appearance & Reading
description: Theme-aware reading preferences and automatic high-resolution Easy TikZ graph publishing.
author: Kolten Bendickson

settings.name: Publish Easy TikZ graphs automatically
settings.description: Render graph blocks to cached PNGs during the garden build. No note changes or export steps. Supports Easy TikZ 4.6 text/JSON and JSON tikz blocks, not raw LaTeX TikZ.

settings.name: Graph PNG resolution multiplier
settings.description: 2 to 4; default 4. Higher resolution keeps diagrams sharp when zoomed or printed.

settings.name: Theme mode support
settings.description: Auto reads the installed theme's CSS. Override for themes that do not declare conventional mode selectors.
